annotations.text:
Bento — traveller-facing screens.

Static mockups, matched to the app's real design system (globals.css): kon-iro indigo, square corners, hairline rules, Zen Kaku / Newsreader / JetBrains Mono.

Content is a real nine-night Kansai–Sanyo trip scored against the owner profile: standard pace, avoids crowds, shrines + history + scenery, excludes beaches and hiking.
The day view is where the name earns itself — compartment height is proportional to the time each stop actually takes, so an over-packed day looks over-packed before you read a word.
Three engine requirements this drawing surfaced — see the handover: a 'considered and left out' list, a per-stop swap affordance, and cost totals per city rather than per trip.
